title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Environment Re-Validation at Reinstatement
content:
## Rule

How the reinstatement fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is built follows the environment re-validation rule, which counts the calendar days from the agreement's suspended date to today:
- after 30 days or more of suspension, the fee is the tier's reinstatement fee plus one flat 150.00 USD plus 2.50 USD for every seat of the agreement's seat count;
- after 15 up to 29 days, it is the tier's reinstatement fee plus one flat 150.00 USD;
- after a shorter suspension it is the tier's reinstatement fee alone.

## Boundary table

| Calendar days from suspended date to today | Fee built as |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | reinstatement fee alone |
| 15 to 29 | reinstatement fee plus 150.00 |
| 30 or more | reinstatement fee plus 150.00 plus 2.50 per seat |

## Hypothetical figures (reinstatement fee taken as 200.00, seat count 20)

- Suspended 2025-03-01, reinstated 2025-03-15: 14 days, 200.00.
- Reinstated 2025-03-16: 15 days, 350.00.
- Reinstated 2025-03-31: 30 days, 200.00 plus 150.00 plus 50.00, that is 400.00.
